description: Unique ID of the source document in the corpus (DOC001-DOC050). 50 documents: 18 Constitution, 16 government schemes, 16 technical manuals.
File format of the source document: PDF, Word, HTML, Markdown or TXT. Fixed per document (made consistent during cleaning).
Unique ID of one text chunk (CHK00001 onward). A chunk is the unit stored in the vector database and retrieved for a question.
Number of words in the chunk. Range 50-499. Controls how much context is given to the LLM.
Cosine-similarity score between the question embedding and the chunk embedding. Higher = chunk is more relevant to the question.
Kind of user question: factual, analytical, comparative, procedural or summarization.
Quality rating of the generated answer (correctness, completeness, groundedness) on a 0-1 scale. Higher is better.
Chunk length group made from word_count: short, medium, long, very_long.
Retrieval score group: low (<0.6), fair, good, excellent (>0.9).
Average of retrieval_score and answer_quality_score; one overall health number per chunk/query.
1 if retrieval_score < 0.6 or answer_quality_score < 0.65. These rows need human review before the answer is trusted.
Corpus group of the document: Constitution, Govt schemes or Technical manual.
